title: spaex Publisher Root Manifest v4
description: Schema for the root `manifest.json` of a publisher repo. Maps molecule ids to their internal directory paths. Molecule versions are authoritative in each molecule's own manifest; the legacy publisher-entry version is accepted for backward compatibility but ignored.

publisher.description: Publisher's reverse-DNS namespace. Every molecule-id key in `molecules` MUST start with `publisher + '.'`.

molecules.description: Map from molecule-id to the publisher-repo-relative directory containing that molecule's `manifest.json`.

repoRelativePath.description: Repository-relative POSIX path with no leading/trailing slash, no control characters, no empty, `.`, or `..` segments.

version.description: Deprecated legacy metadata. The molecule manifest is the sole source of truth for the molecule version.
